en: A black and white postcard showing a historic castle perched dramatically on a rocky cliff above a river or lake. The building features tall spires and several roofs, characteristic of medieval European castles. In the background, smoke rises from an industrial building near the water, with another large castle-like structure visible on the distant hill. There are tall, dark pine trees framing the scene and leafless trees indicating the season may be late autumn or winter. There is no visible modern development.
